title: Density Increment Generalization to k-APs via Gowers Norms
description: Formalizes the generalization of Roth's density increment to k-term arithmetic progressions using Gowers uniformity norms. For k=3, Fourier analysis suffices (U² norm). For k≥4, the U^{k-1} norm controls k-AP counts via the generalized von Neumann theorem.

meta.author: Gowers (2001), Green-Tao-Ziegler (2012)
meta.assumptions: 4 axioms: gowersNorm (U^s norm function), kAPCount (k-AP counting operator), generalized_von_neumann (k-AP count controlled by U^{k-1} norm), density_increment_kAP (density increases on subprogression for k-AP-free sets). Removed: gowersNorm_nonneg, gowersNorm_mono (unused), inverse_theorem (had placeholder True conclusion).
